styleLock.direction: guochao ink-street menswear outerwear lookbook: die-cut collage key visuals on a distressed ink wall, ghost front-and-back pair screens and a cool studio lookbook
styleLock.backgroundSystem: one flat field per screen and never a staged space: distressed ink-green plaster wall #22312C carries the die-cut cover, the side-profile prop screen and the closing screen, seamless moon-white studio sweep #E3E9E6 carries the hung pair, the three-figure orbit lookbook, the weave macro and the care rail, pale celadon insert board #CFDCD2 carries the closure macro, the spec grid and the two-state comparison; muted wisteria violet #6E63A6 appears only as empty discs, index pills, rules and a blank button plate, never as a full field
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool even studio light around 6200K, broad front key with a fill card on the shadow side, one hard rim used only against the ink-green wall, low contrast, one soft contact shadow that always grounds the garment or the cutout, one oblique side light reserved for the two macro screens to read the woven surface; no warm cast, no harsh specular hotspot
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless moon-white studio sweep #E3E9E6 with a faint scuff, matte pale celadon insert board #CFDCD2 for the closure macro, the spec grid and the two-state comparison, distressed ink-green plaster wall #22312C for the cover, the side-profile screen and the closing screen, one thin strip of pale concrete-grey floor appearing only where a hem meets the ground; no wood, no marble slab, no stone riser, no fabric drape used as a surface
styleLock.typography: one mid-weight grotesque family for every rendered line; Chinese display headlines set wide with heavy letter-spacing, one letterspaced uppercase Latin micro rail run vertically along the left edge, one display line doubled with an offset ghost copy, hairline double rules and dashed rules as the label system, headline 26-40pt, label 12-16pt; every rendered Chinese string comes from a selling_point or callout placeholder slot and never from source copy; no serif, no calligraphic or handwritten lettering
styleLock.iconSystem: single-weight pictograms drawn inside square frames with one open corner, one solid ink-green pointer triangle as the only filled marker, blank violet index pills and one empty disc as corner markers; never circles holding medallion icons, never spheres, never 3D badges, never two icon dialects in one screen
styleLock.presentationRules: the garment is always the outermost open-fronted layer at identical scale on every screen; hung or ghost views keep a straight-on read, worn views are framed neck-down or as full-body die-cut cutouts traced with a pale keyline, one dashed orbit line may link cutouts of different scale; inner layers and trousers stay plain and never carry legible text or graphics
noDrift: no random backgrounds or scenic depth
no inconsistent lighting or warm cast
no filled-in numbers, prices, size values or certification marks
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent guochao ink-street menswear outerwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of distressed ink-green #22312C, seamless moon-white studio field #E3E9E6, pale celadon insert board #CFDCD2 and one muted wisteria violet accent #6E63A6, with reversed pale type #F4F6F3 on dark fields; cool even studio light around 6200K, broad front key with a fill card, one hard rim only against the ink-green wall, soft contact shadow that always grounds the garment, one oblique side light reserved for macro screens; flat fields only, the only set devices being a pale die-cut keyline, one dashed orbit line, open-corner square icon frames and a solid ink pointer triangle; one mid-weight grotesque family with heavy letter-spacing plus one vertical letterspaced uppercase Latin rail; garment presented on invisible torso forms, on generic adult male bodies framed neck-down, or flat laid, always at the same scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no serif or calligraphic lettering, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand wordmarks, no filled-in numbers.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：屏1 暗墨绿斑驳墙面上的裁贴拼贴封面，两名成年男模各穿一件石绿底橘红印花立领盘扣外套，裁片外缘描一圈纸白粗描边，右上角一枚紫底圆形角标，左侧一条紫蓝空色块与一条斜放英文小字竖排轨，底部一条青绿通栏色带上压字距拉开的英文店招字标（原句已剥离），最底为一段深色衣物洗涤中文提示；屏2 上半七行洗护中文说明加「洗涤说明」五分格线性图标轨（手洗／低温熨烫／不可漂白／不可烘干／自然晾干），下半「细节展示」标题加一枚黑色实心下指箭头加四格外套局部图（门襟盘扣、印面、成排扣合、翻起的袖口）；屏3 左上延续袖口局部图，右侧幽灵式正身与背身外套双像并列，其下三行英文小字段，再下「模特信息」区块为一枚颈下头像块加三行身重与号型数值，「尺码信息」区块为四列量位表头加四档实测数值行加一行手工测量误差小字（数值一律未搬运）；屏4 「模特展示」区块：净白场上三名男模全身裁片，一条虚线椭圆轨迹串起三档不同比例，中央人物脚下压一枚灰色椭圆影，其下一条重复叠印两次的英文标语带（原句已剥离），下方接一格冷灰蓝场的持扇男模半身；屏5 两格棚拍：上格颈下裁切胸腹段、双手在胸前展开一把朱红折扇，下格肩胸微侧把合扇搭在肩上；屏6 上格衣摆与腰下裁切，中部再次出现同一条英文标语带加两行英文小字（原句已剥离），下部两格全身正身与微侧身；屏7 一条英文小字居中（原句已剥离），其下一格全身敞开甩袖动态图，外套掀开露出同印面里料；屏8 一整格颈下持扇正面图，底部再一次同一条英文标语带加两行英文小字；屏9 两格同姿不同大小的并列裁切（小格在左大格在右），其下一格甩袖动态图并把标语带直接压在图面上；屏10 上格衣摆与素白球鞋在浅灰水泥地上的局部，中部一条英文小字（原句已剥离），下部一格戴渔夫帽压帽檐的半身正面（帽上中文刺绣字已剥离），左下角一枚黑底两行反白会员促销色块接一枚二维码。本套不是店铺活动承接页也不是装修样机：十屏全部有真实实拍与真人模特，仅屏1 左上的紫蓝色块与屏6、屏10 的灰色块属纯色空图位（未加载或纯色承载），模板侧一律按空图位处理，未凭空补任何场景实物。品类判定依据（L1 与夹名「男装」一致，L2 按硬证据定为「外套」而非上衣或下装）：一，主体是一件立领、通身敞襟、门襟成排中式盘扣的短外套，屏2 与屏3 把门襟扣合逐枚拍清，屏4 至屏10 模特一律把它穿在最外层并敞开，内里另有一件长身素色打底，属外套穿法而非套头上衣，故不取「上衣」；二，屏3 的幽灵式正身与背身双像只给这一件外套，屏2 四格局部全是它自己的门襟、印面与翻袖口，页内没有任何下装获得独立正背双像或微距，故主体不是下装；三，「尺码信息」四列列名是裤装量位（腰围／臀围／裤口／裤长），与男装(31→男装／下装 所依据的裤长／臀围／大腿围／腰围／脚口五列成人裤表不同，本页既无大腿围列，其裤长档数值又与实拍落地长裤明显矛盾，属店铺复用的样板表，不足以改判 L2，且页内零肩宽零胸围列，与男装(3→女装／外套 的 S 码肩宽胸围女码判据完全不成立；四，模特性别年龄：屏1、4、5、6、8、9、10 为同一成年男模，短发、平胸、男式五官体型，模特信息档位亦为成人量级，故不改判女装／外套，也不涉及母婴／童装与儿童面容；五，无鞋类判据：页内无楦码档、无脚长毫米列、无鞋眼与外底纹样，鞋只是一双素白球鞋入镜且从不单独特写，故与男装(33→鞋靴／男鞋
